description: Source code implementing memory management, virtual address space handling, page frame management, and demand paging for Zephyr OS kernel.

classes.name: struct z_page_frame
classes.description: Metadata structure for a physical page frame, including flags and address.

methods.name: z_page_frames_dump
methods.description: Dumps the current state of all page frames with color coding.

methods.name: page_frame_dump
methods.description: Helper function to dump individual page frame status.

methods.name: free_page_frame_list_get
methods.description: Retrieves an available page frame from the free list.

methods.name: free_page_frame_list_put
methods.description: Returns a page frame to the free list.

methods.name: page_frame_free_locked
methods.description: Frees a page frame and adds it to the free list.

methods.name: frame_mapped_set
methods.description: Marks a page frame as mapped to a virtual address.

methods.name: virt_to_page_frame
methods.description: Finds the page frame corresponding to a virtual address.

methods.name: map_anon_page
methods.description: Allocates and maps an anonymous page to a virtual address.

methods.name: k_mem_map
methods.description: Maps a region of physical memory into virtual address space.

methods.name: k_mem_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps a virtual memory region and frees associated page frames.

methods.name: k_mem_free_get
methods.description: Returns the number of free page frames.

methods.name: z_mem_manage_init
methods.description: Initializes memory management, including page frames and demand paging setup.

methods.name: z_mem_manage_boot_finish
methods.description: Finalizes boot-time memory setup, unpinning boot sections.

methods.name: do_backing_store_page_in
methods.description: Performs a page-in operation from backing store with timing histogram.

methods.name: do_backing_store_page_out
methods.description: Performs a page-out operation to backing store with timing histogram.

methods.name: do_page_fault
methods.description: Handles a page fault, including eviction, paging in/out, and pinning.

methods.name: k_mem_page_in
methods.description: Performs page-in for a memory region.

methods.name: k_mem_page_out
methods.description: Performs page-out for a memory region.

methods.name: k_mem_pin
methods.description: Pins a memory region in physical memory.

methods.name: k_mem_unpin
methods.description: Unpins a memory region.
